> **Part 4a of a 2-hour session.** This first hour builds a real DESeq2 pipeline
> locally in Positron. Hour 2 ([Apptainer](08-apptainer.qmd)) packages this same
> pipeline in a container so it runs identically on any operating system.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this hour you will be able to:

- **Execute** a DESeq2 differential expression pipeline on a shared RNA-seq dataset
- **Organize** the analysis as a scripted, re-runnable pipeline inside an R Project
- **Interpret** DESeq2 output (log2 fold change, adjusted p-values) in the context of the experimental design

## Prerequisites

ARCS Parts 1–3, or equivalent comfort with R Projects, the tidyverse, and Git.
